name: usage-engineer
description: Cut wasted tokens in Codex sessions: compact long logs, stop repeated failures, detect stale project maps, and audit where local Codex and OpenCode usage went. Local only, no network.

interface.longDescription: Usage Engineer keeps agent sessions cheap without lowering quality. Long build and test logs are compacted to every error line plus the tail, with a byte-exact copy on disk. Repeated identical failures trigger a change of approach. Project maps are checked for staleness before work resumes, so only changed files are re-read. A read-only audit reports where local Codex CLI and OpenCode usage went, including oversized tool outputs and repeated tool calls. Everything runs locally through a bundled zero-dependency Python script; it makes no network calls and never reads credentials or chat text.
defaultPrompt: Where did my Codex usage go this week?
Run the tests and show me only the failures
Check whether my project map is stale before we continue
